1elear4: Wendel Elear arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in U-F10 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Wendel Elear started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Elear. Wendel Elear read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
benmarine7: Matthias Benmarine arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in T-F6 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Matthias Benmarine read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A rat stole Matthias Benmarine's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
bubik_233: The new rifleman is Tobias Bubik, once a printer's apprentice from Tannenfeld. The corporal asked if a printer's apprentice was any use in a trench. Tobias Bubik said he would find out.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Tobias Bubik heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Tobias Bubik and Norbert Littlesaint sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
cade42623: On Day 9, Quentin Cade arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-C15, Quentin Cade listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Quentin Cade saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-C15 and fired once. Hugo Jameson was grazed.
chubkis117: Arno Chubkis signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at Q-F1 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Arno Chubkis. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
colinhydee: Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Benedikt Preston came out for a cup and was grazed.
da_moovin: Day 4: Leopold "Brick" Moovin reached S-F19 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
A clear shot from S-F19. Leopold "Brick" Moovin grazed Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong and slid back down below the parapet.

Leopold "Brick" Moovin lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Leopold "Brick" Moovin watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet went through Leopold "Brick" Moovin's sleeve at S-F19 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga of the Hegemony (@filip_ogwanga). Leopold "Brick" Moovin had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor crossed it, Leopold "Brick" Moovin fired. Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor was gravely wounded.
Leopold "Brick" Moovin no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A shell hit the latrine at S-F19. Nobody was hurt. Leopold "Brick" Moovin says it was the best day of the war.
The parcel for Leopold "Brick" Moovin contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.

The Hegemony raiders came over at S-F19 in the middle of the night. Leopold "Brick" Moovin met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Felix "Bones" Kurlkale of the Hegemony (@kurlkale).
The House of Moovin sent Pavel Moovin after Leopold "Brick" Moovin. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-F19. Pavel Moovin fired at the last man to run. Quentin "Shadow" Clan was grazed.
jwessels530: Ulrich Jwessels came up the line with a dented harmonica and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. The transfer made Ulrich Jwessels a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself. Ulrich Jwessels bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

On a quiet night Matthias Mart (Concord) and Ulrich Jwessels (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter from home found Ulrich Jwessels before the night shift. Ulrich Jwessels folded it small and kept it close.

Ulrich Jwessels crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F4 holds again. A letter from home found Ulrich Jwessels before the night shift. Ulrich Jwessels folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 has been won. Ulrich Jwessels listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Ulrich Jwessels caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Ulrich Jwessels was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Ulrich Jwessels followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.
Ulrich Jwessels (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Tobias Noirangelfan (Concord) at Blackwater Canal. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich Jwessels watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A pump handle snapped off in Ulrich Jwessels's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
lagbagdotzip: Severin Lagbagdotzip came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Severin Lagbagdotzip fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin "Shadow" Danny, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. After what happened at Verdel Ridge, Severin Lagbagdotzip asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.

Part of the parapet collapsed near Severin Lagbagdotzip. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.

Severin Lagbagdotzip wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Severin Lagbagdotzip during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Severin Lagbagdotzip fired at a movement across the wire at R-F19. The man went down: Teodor Deanc, grazed. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F19 and grazed Severin Lagbagdotzip's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia of the Concord (@rachelejosiah). A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Severin Lagbagdotzip is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.
Severin Lagbagdotzip owes Felix Lowelleast so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.

Severin Lagbagdotzip wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Severin Lagbagdotzip used it. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed was badly wounded. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Severin Lagbagdotzip listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
A bullet grazed Severin Lagbagdotzip's ribs at R-F19. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Ivo "Bones" David of the Concord (@david2449_).
manthatsmental1: Konrad Manthatsment arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a frozen apple and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Konrad "Mud" Pawington, grazed. Konrad Manthatsment cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Konrad Manthatsment wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Konrad Manthatsment drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
maupat_03: Ivo Maupat arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a photograph gone soft at the edges and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ivo Maupat could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Face blackened with soot, Ivo Maupat spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Karel Jonas was grazed.
pgallo102: Ulrich Pgallo was a tram conductor in Rosenau until the posters went up. He came to S-F5 with a tin whistle, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake. The transfer made Ulrich Pgallo a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Ulrich Pgallo wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Ulrich Pgallo lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.

Ulrich Pgallo took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. Victory at Hill 304. Ulrich Pgallo let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A bullet went through Ulrich Pgallo's sleeve at S-F5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626).
Ulrich Pgallo's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
A bullet grazed Ulrich Pgallo's ribs at S-F5. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple).

Ulrich Pgallo was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-F5. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar of the Concord (@corporalstars). Ulrich Pgallo stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F5. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar of the Concord (@corporalstars).
Ivo Pgallo had heard about Ulrich Pgallo's courage. At S-F5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Ivo Pgallo folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A recruit asked Ivo Pgallo how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
poysner: Valentin "Saint" Poysner arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a cracked shaving mirror and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
An empty jam tin became Valentin "Saint" Poysner's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
stonewall.61: "You're late," said the corporal when Jonas Stonewall arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Blackwater Canal is lost. Jonas Stonewall heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
On sentry duty Jonas Stonewall watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
thedukeofvelour: Roland "Saint" Thedukeofvel came up on Day 10 carrying news from Wyvern Cross. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Roland "Saint" Thedukeofvel in the open at P-F15. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Yann Watt of the Hegemony (@jake_watt1236). Roland "Saint" Thedukeofvel looked over the parapet at P-F15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Yann Watt of the Hegemony (@jake_watt1236).
Jakub Thedukeofvel asked about Roland "Saint" Thedukeofvel on arriving at P-F15. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
theexpendableguard: The quartermaster asked Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl and Pavel Huntertheyan both swear they saw a ghost at the Hanging Bridge. Each says the other screamed first.
tomtomaustheim: By the time Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe reached R-R9, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
volodymyr_kryvolap: The draft reached Q-F1 on Day 9. Edmund Kryvolap was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Edmund Kryvolap kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Henrik Barringarms and Edmund Kryvolap tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
